summary: One branch-wide pass over PH-2's product diff (64KB; the .factory evidence in the same range was 122KB and excluded so the bundle stayed inside the size limit), plus per-stage local reviews: five rounds on PH-2.1, one on PH-2.2, three on PH-2.3, one on PH-2.4. Every round found something real. The single branch finding was a P3 on duplicated lesson records, fixed before landing.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The union merge driver duplicated three lesson records, up to three copies each. Consumers inject every matching row into generated briefs, so duplicates compound into every future prompt. Deduped first-occurrence-wins in a bounded quickfix; the underlying cause is decision 0022's case.

residual_risks: PH-2.1 needed five review rounds: derive validating against epics it was about to delete, --repo ignored when resolving source_refs, import trusting stale stored epics, whitespace passing as content, and an unhashable-type crash on malformed JSON. Each was a real bypass of the contract the story adds.

The epic contract binds at the three authoring routes only. save_roadmap, mark_status, cmd_assign, cmd_link_spec and cmd_heal keep the weaker check by design, so a legacy roadmap still loads, still flips status, and still heals.
